title: Welcome to Lampy Paperwork V36
paragraphs: Lampy Paperwork is a browser-based workspace for creating and managing the technical paperwork used on live entertainment productions. It brings fixture patching, power, distro and Fan Out documentation, control systems, network devices, rack layouts, exports, and project records together in one place.
The app keeps related project information connected, reduces repeated data entry, and produces clear paperwork that can move with a production from planning through delivery.

V36 adds brand-aware VLAN defaults. Generic VLANs remain the default, while Luminex or Pathway network devices load their matching template when the VLAN setup has not been customised. Your VLAN names and colours remain editable.

Lampy Paperwork remains under active development. Features, layouts, workflows, and saved data may change while the app is tested and improved. Download and keep regular copies of your Lampy project file.
